scope: Explicit personal Artbook try-on in real multi-outfit editor. Nine separate generated head/hair drawings, registered to existing two body forms with scoped hair/garment colour filters. No new personal appearance persistence or main-avatar replacement.

existingAppAndAtelier.consoleCaveat: Existing baseline acceptance includes optional-resource/offline fetch messages and deliberate stale-tab conflict; no uncaught page errors.

checks: Actual editor retains original Artbook route by default; personal atlas is not decoded until explicit opt-in
Explicit personal opt-in uses existing hair/colour/expression/accent without body inference, profile writes, draft changes or original body edits
Old head pixels are completely excluded above registered collar; face keeps skin colour, hair/garment filters are scoped and alpha-preserving
Actual variant dropdowns and A/B body control redraw registered layers while keeping profile unchanged
162 real rasterized combinations across two forms retain body/equipment geometry and unique IDs; three expressions and hair colours differ in actual pixels
Original-versus-delivery pixel comparison preserves every alpha value with bounded visible colour error
All 95 prototype article identities compose with new personal layers on both forms without profile or inventory writes
Switching off restores original artwork and masks; explicit outfit Save writes no try-on appearance or unrelated profile fields
Actual personal controls stay contained at 320/390/430px and clearly disclose try-on-only behaviour in DE/EN
Corrupt personal atlas fails before partial composition, keeps original preview/data and supports explicit successful retry
First personal opt-in on a fresh offline page and after reload uses critical cached atlas with genuine worker/IndexedDB

visualReview.bodyComparison: Six full-figure real renderer studies: two bodies × three hairstyles, with the six PNG prototype article set.
visualReview.expressionComparison: Nine actual renderer head closeups: three expressions × three hairstyles with three-part headband.
visualReview.findings: No obvious floating head, collar gap or displaced start-set equipment in the inspected fixed-pose studies; headband remains in proper front/back hair depth. Not a universal final premium fit approval.

limits: One adult three-quarter pose and two explicit existing body forms. Complete personal body, face and skin range remains open.
Nine drawings and scoped colour treatments are prototypes; final hand-painted palettes, premium item artwork and universal fit are not certified.

162 appearance variants are checked on the six-PNG start set. All 95 article identities compose on each body; this is not exhaustive visual approval of every possible 95-item outfit and personal combination.
Personal controls are session-only try-on. No profile/ownership changes, persistent personal setting or new main-avatar route in this phase.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, installed-old-PWA upgrade, quota and GPU peak acceptance remain open.
